front_line: The infrastructure layer between demand, delivery, and the internet itself.
thesis: Amazon is not just a store. It is the infrastructure layer between consumer demand, delivery, cloud computing, advertising, and the internet economy itself. The bull case is that AWS, ads, retail margins, logistics efficiency, and AI all compound at the same time, turning Amazon from a high-revenue machine into a much better profit machine. An elite business at a fair price that we believe the market is overlooking.
moat: Three proven, interlocking moats (AWS switching costs, logistics scale, Prime habit) that defend the installed base far better than the next AI workload.
risks: Two consecutive EPS misses (-3.0%, -3.6%) after two large beats — deceleration warning has already half-fired.

video_talking_points: Amazon runs four businesses that feed each other.

Open. An elite, three-moat business trading below its own base case, where the one question that resolves most of the risk lands on a known date — July 29. The verdict flips toward caution if that print shows a third EPS miss, rising capex guidance, and AWS decelerating below rivals — that would turn a monitorable timing risk into a confirmed deceleration with the most valuable moat under pressure.
